series.notes: Indoor display chart for the Carrier Multi Split Ductless line: 38GVM outdoor sizes 18k to 42k and 40GVM indoor sizes 9k to 18k. The published chart is split by indoor size, so several codes exist only on 18K/24K/30K and others only on 36K/42K - each entry repeats that in its notes. Meanings were checked against the HowTo HVAC Carrier chart of 54 rows, which agrees everywhere except F0 and H2 (absent there) and the P0 spelling.

title.en: Low charge or refrigeration system blockage

meaning.en: The board sees a charge or blockage problem - either the circuit has leaked low or something is choked.
meaning.ur: Board ko gas ya blockage ka masla nazar aata hai - ya circuit leak kar ke kam hua ya kuch block hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant charge is low because the circuit has leaked.
causes.ur: Circuit mein gas leak hone ki wajah se charge kam hai.

causes.en: Filter drier, capillary or EXV is choked, so pressures run away.
causes.ur: Filter drier, capillary ya EXV block ho gaya hai, pressure balaa se nikal raha hai.

solutions.en: Have the circuit pressure-tested for leaks, then vacuum and re-gas to spec.
solutions.ur: Circuit ka leak test karwayein, phir vacuum karke specification ke mutabiq gas bharwayein.

solutions.en: Technician to check pressures, replace the blocked filter drier and clear the EXV.
solutions.ur: Technician pressure check kare, block filter drier badle aur EXV clear kare.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

notes.en: Listed only for the 18K, 24K and 30K indoor sizes; the 36K/42K chart marks this code NA. Only RemoveAndReplace publishes this row - the HowTo HVAC Carrier chart (54 rows) leaves it out, so the meaning rests on one brand-specific source.

meaning.en: The outdoor air sensor is open, shorted or reading nonsense, so capacity control goes wrong.
meaning.ur: Outdoor hawa ka sensor open, short ya ghalat reading de raha hai, is liye control bigad jata hai.

causes.en: Sensor lead wire is loose, rat-bitten or shorted where it clips onto the pipe.
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire dheeli hai, chuha ne kaat di hai ya pipe par short ho rahi hai.

causes.en: The thermistor has drifted out of range or failed outright.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho gaya hai ya uski reading ghalat aa rahi hai.

solutions.en: Check the sensor plug and lead, then measure the thermistor and replace it if out of range.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug aur wire check karein, thermistor napein, ghalat ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

title.en: Communication error between indoor and outdoor
title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan communication kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor boards have stopped exchanging data, so the system halts.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor boards data dena band kar dete hain, is liye system ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Indoor to outdoor wiring (L, N, S) is loose, rat-bitten or landed wrongly.
causes.ur: Indoor se outdoor ki wiring (L, N, S) dheeli, chuha kata hui ya ghalat lagi hai.

causes.en: Communication circuit on the indoor or outdoor board has failed.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor board ka communication circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power cycle both units together; communication faults often clear after one clean restart.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka ek sath power cycle karein; communication fault aksar ek saaf restart se theek ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Power off, then re-check and retighten the indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth).
solutions.ur: Power band karke indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth) dobara check aur tight karein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

meaning.en: Two indoor units on the one outdoor unit are asking for opposite modes.

causes.en: Indoor and outdoor units are from different platform or revision levels.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit alag platform/revision ke hain.

solutions.en: Set every indoor unit to the same mode, or let the master unit decide the mode.
solutions.ur: Har indoor unit ko ek hi mode par rakhein, ya mode master unit par chhoonein.

solutions.en: Switch all indoor units off, then start them together in one mode.
solutions.ur: Sab indoor units band karein, phir ek hi mode mein ek sath start karein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

meaning.en: The inverter power module has tripped and gone into rest, so the compressor stops.
